changelog: New Rectangle drawing tool for marking S/R zones and order blocks (FSA gate 3): click-drag corner to corner, 8 resize handles when selected (4 corners free, top/bottom price-only, left/right time-only), dragging inside moves the whole box. Stored normalised so points[0] is always top-left.

Settings panel (Style/Text/Coordinates tabs) with Template dropdown (Save as default/Reset to default), and explicit Cancel/OK -- Cancel reverts every live-preview edit back to what the panel opened with; OK is the only point any of it is actually saved. Style tab: Extend (none/left/right/both, visual reach only), border colour/width/style, an optional middle line at the mid-price, optional background fill with its own opacity. Text tab: optional label, position, size, colour. Coordinates tab: editable Price 1/Time 1, Price 2/Time 2, applying live.

Rectangles always render -- and hit-test -- beneath every other drawing tool and the live trade display, so a zone drawn over a position box or the order ticket's own lines never intercepts a click meant for them, no matter which order they were drawn in.

'rectangle' added to BacktestDrawingController::TOOLS and to the tool ENUM on both backtest_drawings and user_drawing_defaults (migration 2026_10_03_0001_add_rectangle_drawing_tool.sql) -- an annotation only, never read by the replay/order engine.
release_notes: This release HAS a migration (2026_10_03_0001_add_rectangle_drawing_tool.sql) -- back up the database before running it. db_migrations stays [] per this project's own tracked-migration convention (CLAUDE.md section 3A): the file is deployed via the files array below, then applied by visiting migrate.php?mode=run&token=... on live, the same as every other migration this release cycle. New harness driver tools/ui-harness/drive-v3229.mjs (39 assertions) against the stateful mock session 20 -- stubs/api.php gained real drawing persistence (a per-session drawings array, a drawing-id-to-session owner map, and a user_drawing_defaults store) it didn't have before, so the reload/save-as-default assertions are a genuine round trip, not a trusted stub. Covers: draw+reload byte-identical normalised points, all 8 handles via direct hit-test calls plus real mouse drags proving each changes only what it should, axis pills only while selected, Extend/Middle-line/Background verified via real canvas pixel sampling (not just the settings flag), Cancel reverting three fields, Coordinates-tab edit + OK persisting, Save-as-default carrying into a freshly drawn rectangle, and a rectangle drawn directly over a position box (and across the whole chart including the open ticket's own lines) never stealing a click meant for them. drive.mjs, drive-v3223.mjs, drive-v3225.mjs, drive-v3226.mjs, drive-v3227.mjs and drive-v3228.mjs all pass unmodified. php -l and node --check clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean. Renumbering: risk ladder moves to v3.22.10, gate checklist stays v3.23.0.
